Also, I found that the antivirus AVAST blocks writing the renamed files in the local folder. Disbaling the antivirus makes the code work.

I tried to tell the antivirus to allow exiftools but it doesn´t work.

Any clue in both issues? Working in an externa USB drive and antivirus?

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in image rename with external drive and antivirus
parts:
Hi Adrian,
can you try renaming the folder and replace the "á" character and rerun the code? Special characters in file or folder names often cause problems.
About AVAST, I haven't heard of that problem before. Try to tell avast to allow R to manipulate files. Copying is done by R, not exiftool, so R needs to be given permission.
Jürgen
